subject: Evidence request: SDLC rollback playbook + CI gating mapping for SOC 2 intake
messages:
From: Ellis Harper <ellis.harper@assessorfirm.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SDLC rollback playbook + CI gating mapping for SOC 2 intake

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. Northbridge needs a compact evidence bundle for our SOC 2 intake focused on SDLC controls. Specifically we need: 

- Rollback / emergency remediation playbook that was used for production fixes (where applicable).
- Mapping from PR approvals to CI run IDs (sample of last 30 days).
- Proof that CI gating enforces PR approvals / protected branches (screenshots or logs are fine).
- Ephemeral secret rotation evidence for any deploy-time secrets involved in your builds (redacted acceptable).
- A manifest listing all artifacts (filenames, hash, brief descriptions).

Can you deliver a redacted bundle and a short notes file explaining gaps or compensating controls by EOD Apr 30 PST? If you need a template, we can accept a CSV with columns: artifact, path, hash, type, produced_by.

Appreciate it — Ellis
Ellis Harper
Senior Assessor, Axiom Assurance
ellis.harper@assessorfirm.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Harper <ellis.harper@assessorfirm.com>, Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@northbridge.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC rollback playbook + CI gating mapping for SOC 2 intake

Hi Ellis / Natalie,

Thanks — looping in Irene (security lead) and Jordan (CI/CD owner). We'll assemble a scoped bundle and include the CSV manifest you mentioned. Planned deliverables:

- rollback-playbook-v1.2.pdf (redacted playbook with decision matrix)
- ci-runmap-202704.csv (PR -> CI run IDs, sample window: 2027-03-29 to 2027-04-28)
- pr-approval-heatmap.png (branch protection enforcement snapshot)
- kms-rotation-redacted.txt (rotation timestamps, KMS key IDs redacted)
- evidence-manifest-20270429.csv (artifact manifest as requested)

Quick clarifications: for the CI run logs we will provide CI run IDs and link to redacted logs; full logs include secrets and will be redacted before sharing. Also, for emergency rollbacks we have two types: automated rollback via canary monitor + manual rollback playbook — both will be included.

Target: deliver zip to your Drive link by 16:00 PST tomorrow. If you need stricter scoping (e.g., show only commits merged with bypass labels), say so and we will filter.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Partnerships (informal)
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellis Harper <ellis.harper@assessorfirm.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC rollback playbook + CI gating mapping for SOC 2 intake

Rishi / Irene — quick update from CI side. Below is the approach and a sample extract.

Plan:
- Export PR metadata for merges between 2027-03-29 and 2027-04-28 (PR id, author, reviewers, approval timestamps).
- Map to CI run IDs (pipeline id, job names, artifacts produced).
- Pull redacted job traces for 10 representative runs (masking any env/secret output).
- Capture branch protection enforcement: enforce_admins=false, required_reviews=1, status_checks=continuous-integration.

Sample (CSV rows will be in ci-runmap-202704.csv):
PR_4231, merge_commit=9f8a3d, approved_at=2027-04-12T12:03:21Z, ci_run=build-20270412-789, artifact=server-image-9f8a3d.tar
PR_4302, merge_commit=a1b2c3, approved_at=2027-04-19T08:45:02Z, ci_run=build-20270419-201, artifact=agent-package-a1b2c3.zip

Links (will be redacted copies):
- Redacted logs: https://drive.google.com/file/d/CI_LOGS_SAMPLE_REDACTED
- CI dashboard: https://app.ci.redwood.ai/builds?range=2027-04-01_2027-04-29

Attachments I will add to the bundle: pr-approval-heatmap.png and ci-runmap-202704.csv. I will also export the list of runs that triggered an automated canary rollback (3 instances in the window) and annotate reasons.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Reliability Engineer — CI/CD
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Harper <ellis.harper@assessorfirm.com>, Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@northbridge.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC rollback playbook + CI gating mapping for SOC 2 intake

Ellis / Natalie — sending the redacted evidence bundle. Attached are the files listed below and a short manifest that explains what we redacted and why. High-level notes:

- Rollback playbook: describes automated canary rollback + manual escalation matrix. We removed contact phone numbers and internal pager endpoints; preserved decision criteria and approval thresholds.
- CI mapping CSV: includes PR id, merge commit, approver list (emails hashed), CI run IDs, artifact names.
- Heatmap: screenshot of branch protection config and rate of approvals vs. bypass attempts (smoothing applied).
- KMS rotation: timestamps and key aliases provided; key IDs redacted to keep customer-specific key ids private.
- Manifest: evidence-manifest-20270429.csv (artifact, filename, short description, produced_by).

Attachments in this email: rollback-playbook-v1.2.pdf, ci-runmap-202704.csv, pr-approval-heatmap.png, kms-rotation-redacted.txt, evidence-manifest-20270429.csv

If you need any of these items converted into signed PDFs or requiring an additional attestation from our security team, tell me and we'll set that up.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Partnerships Lead (Acting)
Redwood Inference
